dedupe_keys.name: istanbul neighbourhood building counts by construction period and storeys 2017 ibb

description: This İBB open dataset counts buildings in each Istanbul neighbourhood (mahalle) by construction period (before 1980, 1980 to 2000 and after 2000) and by number of storeys (1 to 4, 5 to 9 and 9 to 19), derived from the municipality's MAKS spatial address data for 2016 to 2017. The file has district and neighbourhood names, the neighbourhood's national address code (UAVT) and the six counts; the municipality explains it was prepared to estimate possible earthquake damage and losses and reflects the stock at that time, since Istanbul's building inventory changes constantly. Coverage: all neighbourhoods of Istanbul. Access: free CSV (resource dated January 2021). Licence: İBB Open Data License. Caveats: coarse classes and a 2017 snapshot; the CSV uses a Turkish character encoding that may need conversion. Simulation uses: exposure inputs for neighbourhood-level earthquake loss and urban renewal prioritisation models. Related records: the İBB earthquake scenario results and the Zeytinburnu physics-based seismic risk dataset.
